hints: Two indices moving in the same direction: front chases rear. init to front=0, rear=-1 so that front > rear reads as empty.
enqueue is 'advance rear, then store'; dequeue is 'read at front, then advance front'. Mirror images of the stack's push and pop.
isFull here is only about rear hitting CAP-1. It does not care that slots before front are free - that is the flaw this problem exists to show.
source: Rebuilt from NITC_Lab_S2 Lab9 P2 (hospital patient queue)
title: Linear array queue (and why it wastes space)
